title: SQL Server 2014 becomes generally available
impact: In-memory OLTP tables and a new cardinality estimator arrive; query plans can change after upgrading, so heavy queries need retesting

title: Extended support for Windows XP ends
impact: PCs still on XP get no more security updates, forcing client apps to be tested and moved to Windows 7 or later

title: Microsoft announces that support for .NET Framework 4, 4.5 and 4.5.1 will end in January 2016
impact: Apps can keep their target, but machines must be updated to .NET Framework 4.5.2 or later before the date to stay supported
